_note: Identical to OpenAI's upload except the purpose value — the whole xAI files surface is one field different.
_lifetime: Measured 2026-09-29, and the ORDER is load-bearing: `expires_after` placed AFTER the file is refused 400 -- 'expires_after must appear before the file field' -- and placed before it answers 200 with `expires_at` set. Note that `expires_in_seconds`, Anthropic's spelling, is accepted here with a 200 and silently ignored, so a status code alone would not have caught a wrong field name.
